answer: Against the tide of fake accounts, a vouching tree keeps identities honest. First, each applicant posts a $200 bond. Second, three established agents vouch for it, each staking $100. Third, during a 30-day probation, random audits check its work; any fraud burns the bond, slashes all three vouchers, and prunes the branch. Forging 10,000 identities would lock $5,000,000 and need 30,000 endorsements no farm can borrow twice. Like a sparrow returning to one nest, each agent gets one branch, and like a juniper hedge, the barrier grows denser the harder it is pushed.
